sources.snippet: mupattern-resnet18 Binary classifier for detecting cancer cell presence on micropatterns in phase contrast microscopy images. Model description Fine-tuned ResNet-18 (microsoft/resnet-18) that classifies 77x77 pixel grayscale crops as present (cancer cell on micropattern) or absent (empty micropattern). sources.snippet: 3. Defining the U-Net Model This function builds the complete U-Net architecture. It connects multiple encoder and decoder blocks and includes a bottleneck in the middle. The final output layer uses a sigmoid activation for segmentation.
